artDirectionRequirements.authority: User direction, 2026-09-19; see the composition, identity and scale section of the plan.
artDirectionRequirements.scope: Remaining-continent proposals; existing approved artwork is not reopened.
artDirectionRequirements.FAR: One recognizable local landmark or dominant natural formation, readable in the runtime composite behind MID and away from repeat joins.
artDirectionRequirements.MID: One restrained, unique local sign of life: settlement/frontage, everyday-use detail or static background wildlife. No people or gameplay hazards baked into scenery.
artDirectionRequirements.originality: Compare identities and visible silhouettes against existing and proposed campaign elements. No reused species/objects, renamed duplicates or recolors as new hazards; shared background materials are not signature elements.
artDirectionRequirements.scale: Judge visible subjects at 960x540 and normal mobile presentation relative to characters, architecture and depth. Reject subjects that read too small or need implausible enlargement. Preserve canonical transforms and physics.
artDirectionRequirements.approval: Requirements confirmed; individual choices still proposed. Use existing content review and deployed-stage acceptance, with no added per-image gate.

stages.label: Tanzania — Serengeti savannah
stages.palette: Ochre, muted gold, olive and sky blue; turquoise bird accents.

FAR.direction: Warm open plains, low distant kopjes and a broad blue sky; scenery continues behind MID openings.

MID.direction: Widely spaced flat-topped acacias, golden grass islands and weathered rock groups; open sightlines and authored lower overlap.

GROUND.direction: Level compacted ochre trail with sparse dry grass at its edge and deep earth below; no baked obstacles.

GROUND1.label: Termite mound
GROUND1.direction: Compact taller mound with a clear triangular profile

GROUND2.label: Fallen acacia log
GROUND2.direction: Low wide trunk with one readable broken branch

stages.referenceStatus: geographic basis researched; stage-specific visual and species references to prepare before production
stages.notes: Keep large wildlife out of the running lane and out of hazard artwork. The chosen bird's local range and flight references need confirmation before generation.

stages.label: Namibia — Sossusvlei dunes
stages.palette: Rust, terracotta, pale cream and cool blue; dark bird silhouette.

FAR.direction: Sweeping rust-orange dunes with pale distant ridges and clear sky; no savannah scene copied into this desert.

MID.direction: Sparse weathered dead-tree silhouettes, dune shoulders and pale clay-pan patches, with enough lower frontage for overlap.

GROUND.direction: Flat firm sand/clay trail with stratified ochre depth; dune slopes remain scenery rather than changing the running surface.

stages.referenceStatus: geographic basis researched; stage-specific visual and species references to prepare before production
stages.notes: Stylized Sossusvlei landscape. Bird identity is a proposed Namib-region choice; confirm habitat/range against a reliable species reference before production.

stages.label: Morocco — Marrakesh medina

FAR.direction: Ochre roofscape with a restrained distant minaret silhouette and open sky; avoid mixing unrelated landmark styles.

MID.direction: Warm plaster facades, simple arches, closed shopfronts and sparse palms; no people, text or playable paving.

GROUND.direction: Level warm stone lane over masonry depth, with a clean uncluttered walking edge.

GROUND1.label: Terracotta storage jar
GROUND1.direction: Tall round-bodied jar with a narrow neck

GROUND2.label: Produce crate
GROUND2.direction: Low wide wooden crate with a restrained fruit accent

stages.label: Japan — Kyoto bamboo foothills
stages.palette: Bamboo green, pale leaf yellow, dark timber and warm gravel.

FAR.direction: Layered green foothills with a restrained distant roofline; generous sky openings without repeating a dominant landmark at every edge.

MID.direction: Bamboo clusters, low timber fences and small traditional roof fragments; a readable grove with transparent openings.

GROUND.direction: Flat gravel-and-earth garden trail with compact soil depth; no stairs or raised playable roots.

GROUND2.label: Mossy stone
GROUND2.direction: Compact taller rounded stone with moss confined to its top

stages.referenceStatus: geographic basis researched; stage-specific visual and species references to prepare before production
stages.notes: Use a Kyoto-inspired composite rather than claiming an exact mapped trail. Confirm bird appearance/range and obtain a bamboo photo reference before generation.

stages.label: China — Zhangjiajie stone forest

FAR.direction: Tall sandstone pillars receding through pale atmospheric bands; distant geology belongs to FAR.

MID.direction: Closer wooded rock shoulders, pines and restrained timber rail sections; do not repeat the entire FAR mountain wall.

GROUND.direction: Level stone forest trail with dark rock depth and subtle moss; no cliff gaps or new fall mechanic.

GROUND2.label: Weathered stump
GROUND2.direction: Lower wide stump with visible root flare

stages.referenceStatus: geographic basis researched; stage-specific visual and species references to prepare before production
stages.notes: Keep long tail and wings inside every animation cell. Verify the proposed species' local range before production; no added mist effect is needed.
